parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet, made of polypropylene plastic, is a lightweight and durable cover that fits over the seat.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl when not in use, preventing odors and maintaining hygiene.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged at the back and can rotate upward or downward around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the toilet, made of urea-formaldehyde plastic, provides a smooth and comfortable surface for sitting.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user during use and is designed for comfort and easy cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It is attached to the base via hinges, allowing it to lift up or down along with the lid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the toilet, made of vitreous china ceramic, forms the main structural and functional component.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, contains the water tank and bowl, and connects to the plumbing for flushing and drainage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary once installed.
